Fixed Download PDF under Lightning Web Security. Root cause (DevGss stage probe): LWS evaluates loadScript code without a globalThis, so pdfmake's bundled global lookup returned undefined and initialization threw a TypeError that LWS swallowed, rejecting loadScript with undefined. Any later loadScript of that URL never settles, which the connectedCallback preload turned into a 60-second timeout on every click. The loader now loads lws-global-this.js before unmodified pdfmake 0.2.23 and vfs_fonts.js on the first click, retries failed loads from fresh ?attempt=N URLs, names the failed stage, and bounds each load to 30 s (render 60 s).
